acp-cancel-midstream.notes: session/cancel sent while text was streaming; prompt resolves stopReason=cancelled ~5 ms later; no trailing updates; upstream HTTP stream aborted.

acp-cancel-during-tool.notes: session/cancel sent while an allowed bash tool (sleep 30) was running; prompt resolves cancelled; NO terminal tool_call_update is sent for the running tool.

acp-cancel-at-permission.notes: Client answered the pending request_permission with outcome=cancelled and sent session/cancel; prompt resolves cancelled; tool never gets a terminal update.

acp-github-cancel.notes: Real backend cancel on first agent_message_chunk: 55 more chunks that were already in flight arrive before the cancelled result.

acp-subagent.notes: task tool (kind=other) runs an explore subagent. Subagent tool_call/tool_call_update carry _meta["github.com/copilot"].agentId; subagent text/thought chunks and usage_update carry NO marker and interleave with the parent stream.

acp-provider-error.notes: Provider failures are reported as agent_message_chunk text ("Info: ... Retrying...", then "Error: Authentication failed ...") and the prompt still resolves end_turn - no JSON-RPC error.

acp-load-replay.mode: byok openai offline, new process, same COPILOT_HOME
acp-load-replay.notes: session/load replays history (user_message_chunk, coalesced agent_message_chunk, tool_call + tool_call_update with original ids, no thought chunks) BEFORE the load response.
